Title: Time auction and cards on vampire auctioned

Messages.Author: Coyote
Messages.Body:
I already found that an auctioned vampire from a Malkavian Dementia doesn't return to its previous owner.

www.vekn.net/forum/rules-questions/74904-malkavian-dementia-time-auction#76713

Extra question about this issue

You auctioned a vampire that also has retainers, equipment and/or any other type of card.
They stay with the vampire?
Their controller changes?

Thanks

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Coyote wrote:
> You auctioned a vampire that also has retainers, equipment and/or any other type of card.
> They stay with the vampire?
> Their controller changes?
>
They stay with the vampire. The controller of the minion cards is by default the controller of the minion, so the new controller in this case.
The controller of any master card on them is by default the Methuselah who played them.
